text: Flatten layer, 1 input, 1 output; {Flattened output size} sets the size of flattened output matrix and {Sample time} sets the option to specify sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Flattened output size
params.values: Size of flattened output matrix [1 1 1] (default) | array of positive scalars
